description: This line plot, titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = small," illustrates the change in Word Error Rate (WER) over six epochs for three different fine-tuning methods applied to a small Whisper model. The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis represents WER, scaled linearly from 25.0 to 42.5. The plot displays three distinct lines: the "small AdaLoRA_int4" method is shown as a solid orange line with circular markers, starting at a WER of 35.5 at epoch 0 and decreasing to 30.0 at epoch 6; the "small AdaLoRA_int8" method is depicted as a solid orange line with square markers, beginning at 30.0 at epoch 0 and ending at 25.0 at epoch 6; and the "small int4" method is represented by a dashed orange line with circular markers, starting at 35.5 at epoch 0, peaking at 42.0 at epoch 2, and declining to 30.0 at epoch 6.
